name: cadcraft
description: CADCraft: computer-aided design and drafting — an open-source, clean-room AutoCAD-style app in pure Rust
readme_summary: CADCraft is an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of AutoCAD, built entirely in Rust. It aims to provide a fast and familiar CAD experience with features like command line, object snaps, layers, dimensions, and hatches, running on multiple operating systems and the web.
primary_use_case: A fast, open-source alternative to AutoCAD for computer-aided design and drafting, accessible across multiple platforms and the web.
cover_image_prompt: A skilled artisan, dressed in a modern workshop apron, meticulously crafting a detailed architectural blueprint on a large digital canvas. The blueprint materializes from streams of glowing Rust code flowing from a nearby terminal. The artisan uses a stylus to precisely place elements like object snaps and dimensions, which appear as glowing geometric shapes. Subtle UI elements of CADCraft are visible on a floating screen. The overall scene is a blend of traditional craftsmanship and futuristic digital creation, set in a bright, clean studio. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a focus on clarity and detail, emphasizing the transformation of code into tangible design.

name: filmcraft
description: FilmCraft: An open-source, nonlinear video editor written by scratch in pure Rust
readme_summary: FilmCraft is an open-source, non-linear video editor built from scratch in pure Rust, designed as a clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Premiere Pro's workflow. It offers native support for macOS, Windows, and Linux, with potential for browser-based use via WebAssembly.
key_features: Clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Premiere Pro workflow
Native support for macOS, Windows, and Linux
Custom H.264, HEVC, ProRes, and AAC codecs written in Rust
GPU compositor working in linear light
Frame math on exact integer time
primary_use_case: A desktop and potentially web-based non-linear video editor for users familiar with Adobe Premiere Pro, offering a high-performance, open-source alternative.
cover_image_prompt: A master craftsman, a 'Rust Golem' made of polished metal and glowing circuits, meticulously assembling a vibrant film reel. The golem uses tools that resemble code snippets and data streams to weave together raw footage (represented by scattered digital film strips) into a polished, cinematic output (a perfectly wound reel with glowing highlights). The background is a clean, modern workshop with subtle UI elements of a video editor visible on floating screens. The overall mood is one of precision, creation, and technological artistry. The image should be in a 3D isometric illustration style with a focus on clear visual storytelling and a color palette that blends metallic tones with vibrant cinematic colors.

name: photocraft
description: PhotoCraft: An open-source, photo editor written by scratch in pure Rust
readme_summary: PhotoCraft is an open-source, native image editing application built entirely in Rust, designed as a clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Photoshop. It offers a familiar user interface and supports advanced features like layers, masks, adjustment layers, and full PSD file compatibility.
key_features: Full PSD file support (open, edit, save)
Agent-ready: actions are commands for UI, CLI, or MCP server
Layers, masks, adjustment layers, layer styles, type, vectors, brushes
primary_use_case: A native, high-performance, open-source alternative to professional desktop image editing software like Adobe Photoshop, with a focus on Rust development and PSD compatibility.
cover_image_prompt: A skilled artisan in a clean, modern workshop, meticulously assembling a complex, multi-layered stained-glass window. Each layer of glass represents a different editing feature (like adjustment layers or masks), and the artisan uses specialized Rust-colored tools to precisely place and refine each piece. The input is a raw, unrefined block of crystal, and the output is a vibrant, detailed masterpiece. Subtle digital particles and faint code snippets float in the background, hinting at the underlying software. The overall mood is one of precision, creativity, and craftsmanship. Style: 3D isometric illustration with a bright, clean aesthetic.

name: reddit-tui
readme_summary: Reddit-tui is a lightweight, terminal-based application for browsing Reddit. It allows users to navigate subreddits, view posts and comments, and interact using keyboard shortcuts, all within their command-line interface.
key_features: Support for Redlib backends for enhanced privacy
primary_use_case: Browsing Reddit content directly from the command line interface.
cover_image_prompt: A vintage, brass telescope pointed towards a swirling nebula of Reddit icons and post titles. A user's hands, illuminated by the soft glow of a terminal screen, are seen adjusting the telescope's focus. Small, stylized 'upvote' and 'downvote' arrows float around the nebula. The scene is set in a cozy, dimly lit study, with subtle lines of code faintly visible on a nearby monitor. The overall mood is one of exploration and discovery within a digital space. The image should be in a 3D isometric illustration style, with a warm, inviting color palette and a focus on clear, readable elements.

name: athena-crisis
description: Athena Crisis is a modern-retro turn-based tactical strategy game. Athena Crisis is open core technology.
readme_summary: Athena Crisis is an open-core, turn-based tactical strategy game developed using TypeScript and React. The repository provides the core engine and tools for game development, allowing developers to contribute to or build upon the game's mechanics, while the full game content remains proprietary.
key_features: Open core technology for game development
Modular package structure (athena, apollo, hera, ui, etc.)
primary_use_case: Developing and contributing to the core engine and mechanics of a turn-based tactical strategy game.
cover_image_prompt: A master chess player meticulously arranging intricate, glowing geometric pieces on a holographic board that hovers above a stylized, retro-futuristic control panel. The pieces on the board represent strategic units, and the holographic display shows subtle data streams and code snippets flowing between them, illustrating complex game logic. The background is a dimly lit, high-tech workshop with blueprints of game mechanics scattered around. The overall mood is one of deep strategic thought and technological innovation. The image should be in a 3D isometric illustration style, emphasizing clarity and a sense of intellectual challenge, with the 'Athena Crisis' logo subtly integrated into the control panel.
